review:
A road trip on 5x4 and 40 lines, with three different wilds. Stacked wilds can cover part or all of a reel, and the random Mystery Wilds feature throws in more.

In free spins and respins, the wild girls and wild wheels become sticky for the whole round. Free spins come round often – about once every 91 spins – and the RTP is an excellent 97.18%. Medium volatility, 4,588x max. A cheerful game with solid value.
pros: Excellent 97.18% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 91 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
